from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    if not grid:
        return grid
    flat = [cell for row in grid for cell in row]
    counts = Counter(flat)
    if len(counts) == 0:
        return grid
    # Sort by frequency descending
    sorted_colors = sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])
    most_freq = sorted_colors[0][0]
    second_freq = sorted_colors[1][0] if len(counts) > 1 else None
    return [[2 if cell == most_freq else (1 if cell == second_freq and second_freq is not None else cell) for cell in row] for row in grid]
